status: Locally frozen before new collection/outcomes; not externally preregistered
study: Same-evening exact-maintained-protocol session replication with practical-threshold sensitivity
threshold_rationale: Illustrative absolute per-lookup sensitivity levels spanning sub-millisecond to several-millisecond effects. Every threshold is reported. These are not validated user-perception, utility or population-equivalence bounds. No threshold is selected after seeing new outcomes.
category_rule: above +tau if median paired delta > tau; below -tau if median < -tau; inside [-tau,+tau] otherwise, including exact boundaries. Inside band means only this observed statistic falls inside the chosen sensitivity band, not equivalence.

calibration.caveat: Historical calibration is a separate reference and prediction source, not pooled with new observations. Any source/runtime/OS/network differences are recorded and limit transport interpretation.

analysis.unit: Within-session provider/domain/window/repetition matched complete successful blocks. Failed attempts retained separately; no imputation or trimming.
analysis.magnitude: For every session and window report median paired difference, median absolute paired difference, absolute value of signed median, IQR and observed extrema. A small signed median does not imply small individual effects.
analysis.rates: For every threshold report paired-observation fractions above +tau, inside band and below -tau separately from fractions of window/session medians in each category. Rates have explicit denominators and are descriptive selected-sample frequencies.
analysis.across_sessions: Only sessions with identical recorded source/runtime/OS/provider/protocol fingerprint may share a descriptive group. Use equal-session median of session medians, all session points/range and leave-one-session sensitivity; do not pool thousands of queries as independent session replication. Different builds remain separate.
analysis.uncertainty: No across-session population confidence or equivalence intervals with only three selected sessions. Show observed window/session ranges and IQRs, leave-session changes and sign/category stability. Dependence and unobserved cache/routing remain.
analysis.leave_session: Retrospective leave-one-session-out: within each verified common-build group, forecast held session median by median of other session medians with one weight per training session; score sign, threshold category and absolute point error versus a zero-adjustment predictor. Clearly retrospective, not issued prospective forecasts. At least 3 completed same-build sessions needed for primary leave-session summary.
analysis.prospective: Apply the four fixed Nov20 calibrated point/sign/category forecasts to each of the three held new sessions. Score without re-fitting on new data; this is a transport check, with build differences explicit. No p-values; all 4 thresholds and all planned sessions remain visible.
analysis.incomplete: Do not inspect/analyze outcome records of running sessions. Missing/running/failed sessions remain listed with status; completed but structurally invalid sessions are excluded with audit reasons. A completed grid may contain failed queries; successful-pair estimates are conditional and counts remain explicit. Never silently replace sessions or claim planned equals observed.

scope: Three spaced sessions on the same evening only. No multi-day claim; no geographic/network population inference, CPU attribution, pure cryptographic cost or general web performance claim.
